name: Vino Nobile di Montepulciano
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

blurb.text: A red DOCG from vineyards around the town of Montepulciano in Tuscany. It is aged at least two years, with at least one year in wood, or three years as riserva.
